profile_text.body:
TruEra / Snowflake is tracked under that name, with its site at trulens.org. The material it publishes centers on TruLens, which it describes as open source and OpenTelemetry-native. According to the site, TruLens instruments an AI agent with OpenTelemetry, scores every step with benchmarked LLM judges, and indicates which version to ship. The company says the tool identifies where an agent fails and where cost can be cut without losing quality.

TruLens is listed as an AI governance and risk management platform. Its recorded capabilities include open-source LLM evaluation through feedback functions, a RAG Triad covering groundedness, context relevance, and answer relevance, and OpenTelemetry tracing. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
